note: Hand-written stand-in for a model response so the demo runs without an API key. Re-record with --llm record.

output.explanation: Capture had no PayPal-Request-Id. When the capture response got lost and the buyer's browser retried, PayPal saw a second capture, answered ORDER_ALREADY_CAPTURED, and the shop never recorded a payment it had actually taken. The header is now derived from the order id, so a retried capture gets the original result back.
